profile.name: Ashandi Leonadi
profile.slogan:
Shipping products,
from data to interface.

meta.description: Ashandi Leonadi, software product engineer in Jakarta shipping production web and mobile products with React, Next.js, TypeScript, and AI.

en.contactCopy: If you're building a product and care about how it holds up in real use, I'd love to hear about it.
en.noteContact:
05 / It starts here
A good product starts with a conversation.
en.aboutTwo: Since then I've moved closer to the whole product: OpenAI-powered PDF reports, offline-first sync on TanStack DB and GPS telemetry on DynamoDB at MapTrack, and now security remediation and commerce flows for Sampoerna and Teazzi at Zero One Group. I hold a Bachelor of Computer Science from Binus Online Learning (GPA 3.69).
en.aboutOne: I started as a frontend intern at Happy5 in 2020, building PDF exports and end-to-end tests, then stayed on to ship React and React Native apps, lead code reviews, mentor interns, and build a shared component library in Storybook.

id.introOne: Saya membangun produk web dan mobile yang berjalan di production, memegang fitur dari model data sampai antarmuka yang dipakai orang setiap hari.
id.introTwo: Saat ini di {company:zeroone}. Sebelumnya membangun laporan berbasis AI dan aplikasi lapangan offline-first di {company:maptrack}, serta lima tahun mengerjakan web dan mobile di {company:happy5}.
id.introThree: Next.js dan TypeScript di depan, Supabase, Laravel dan DynamoDB di belakang, dengan OpenAI dan retrieval-augmented generation saat memang dibutuhkan.
id.writingIntro: Catatan singkat tentang masalah yang pernah saya selesaikan di production.

id.aboutOne: Saya mulai sebagai frontend intern di Happy5 pada 2020, membuat ekspor PDF dan end-to-end test, lalu lanjut membangun aplikasi React dan React Native, memimpin code review, membimbing intern, dan membuat component library di Storybook.
id.aboutTwo: Sejak itu saya semakin dekat ke produk secara utuh: laporan PDF berbasis OpenAI, sinkronisasi offline-first dengan TanStack DB dan telemetri GPS di DynamoDB di MapTrack, dan kini perbaikan keamanan serta alur commerce untuk Sampoerna dan Teazzi di Zero One Group. Lulusan S1 Ilmu Komputer Binus Online Learning (IPK 3.69).
id.contactCopy: Kalau kamu sedang membangun produk dan peduli bagaimana produk itu bertahan saat dipakai, saya senang mendengarnya.

projects.title: Shopbot Assistant
description: AI shopping assistant on WhatsApp for small online sellers.
Asisten belanja AI di WhatsApp untuk penjual online kecil.
projects.role: Next.js · Supabase · OpenAI · WhatsApp Cloud API
projects.label: Independent project
body: Shopbot Assistant answers shoppers on WhatsApp on behalf of small e-commerce sellers.
Retrieval-augmented generation over Supabase vector search grounds every reply in the shop's own catalogue, so product recommendations and support answers stay accurate as the catalogue changes.

projects.title: Expense Tracker
description: Personal finance app with spending categories and visual breakdowns.
Aplikasi keuangan pribadi dengan kategori pengeluaran dan visualisasi.
projects.role: Laravel · Inertia.js · React.js · SQLite · Shadcn UI
projects.label: Independent project
body: Expense Tracker categorises spending and shows where the money goes with visual breakdowns.
Server-driven UI through Inertia.js gives SPA responsiveness without maintaining a separate API layer.

projects.title: Stoqu Inamawangi
description: Inventory and order management with real-time stock movement.
Manajemen inventori dan pesanan dengan pergerakan stok real-time.
projects.label: Independent project
body: Stoqu Inamawangi handles real-time stock movement and customer order processing.
The backend is written in Go, chosen for concurrent write throughput.

articles.title: Offline-first field apps
description: Keeping field crews recording in low-signal areas.
Membuat kru lapangan tetap bisa mencatat di area sinyal lemah.
body: At MapTrack, field crews work where signal drops out. Rebuilding the data layer on TanStack DB made the app offline first: crews keep recording, and changes sync automatically once connectivity returns.

articles.title: From form definitions to print-ready reports
articles.short: From form definitions to print-ready reports
description: Replacing a manual report step with OpenAI.
Mengganti langkah laporan manual dengan OpenAI.
body: Field teams used to prepare reports by hand. An OpenAI-powered PDF generation system now turns custom form definitions into structured, print-ready reports.

articles.title: Migrating to TypeScript without pausing delivery
articles.short: Migrating to TypeScript without pausing delivery
description: Incremental migration over a big-bang rewrite.
Migrasi bertahap, bukan rewrite sekaligus.
body: At Happy5 and Kodegiri, legacy JavaScript moved to TypeScript module by module, so type safety landed across the product while features kept shipping.

summary: Security remediation across Sampoerna apps, plus the Teazzi back office and customer ordering flows.
Perbaikan keamanan di aplikasi Sampoerna, serta back office dan alur pemesanan pelanggan Teazzi.
OpenAI-powered PDF reports, offline-first sync on TanStack DB, GPS telemetry on DynamoDB, and an interactive asset map.
Laporan PDF berbasis OpenAI, sinkronisasi offline-first dengan TanStack DB, telemetri GPS di DynamoDB, dan peta aset interaktif.
Revamped the VRMS web app and migrated it to TypeScript.
Merombak aplikasi web VRMS dan migrasi ke TypeScript.
Production React components with React Query and Styled Components.
Komponen React production dengan React Query dan Styled Components.
Rebuilt legacy pages in Next.js and created shared API utilities.
Membangun ulang halaman lama dengan Next.js dan membuat utilitas API bersama.
Led code reviews, mentored interns, built a Storybook component library, Cypress E2E, and the Happy5 Culture app in React Native.
Memimpin code review, membimbing intern, membuat component library Storybook, E2E Cypress, dan aplikasi Happy5 Culture dengan React Native.
PDF export for performance reviews and Cypress end-to-end tests.
Ekspor PDF untuk review kinerja dan end-to-end test Cypress.
